approach: Copy the three archived texts with `git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:<path>`, take only the records-history parts, renumber D112 to D111, and adjust any text that depends on this branch's state. The planner could only read, so the archive was not read. The producer must read it first.

decisions.choice: Take the archived D112 entry verbatim except for the heading and self-references (D111), and append it after D110 at the end of docs/decisions.md (line 2553 is D110, the last entry).
decisions.reason: D111 is free here. The brief asks for the archived text unchanged except for state that differs on this branch.

rejected.option: Cherry-pick or merge the archive commits
rejected.why: They also carry the spec job's D111, spec.toml, ontology.toml and enforcement.md.
The brief says to use the next free number, D111, which leaves no gap.

decisions.choice: Search the design, the decision and the CHANGELOG entries for references to the left-out spec-job material: archived D111, spec.toml, ontology.toml, enforcement.md. Adjust only those. If none are found, keep the text exactly.
decisions.reason: The brief allows changes only where the text describes state that differs on this branch.

rejected.why: The verifier compares the text with the archive, so extra edits count as differences.

decisions.choice: Put the two CHANGELOG entries under [Unreleased] in the subsection where the archive has them. The existing Added bullets end at line 27 and '### Fixed' is at line 29.
decisions.reason: The brief requires them under [Unreleased], and this follows the existing layout.

rejected.why: The brief says the entries go under [Unreleased].

files.purpose: Archived design with D112 changed to D111 and branch-state adjustments only.
Append the D111 accepted decision after D110, using the archived D112 text.
Add the two records-history entries under [Unreleased], with D112 changed to D111.

steps: Read the three archived texts with git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:docs/design/records-history.md, :docs/decisions.md and :CHANGELOG.md. Find the D112 entry and the two CHANGELOG entries.

Create docs/design/records-history.md from the archive. Change every D112 to D111. Find references to the archived D111, spec.toml, ontology.toml and enforcement.md, and adjust them only where this branch differs.

Append the archived D112 entry to docs/decisions.md after D110 (the file ends at line 2578), headed '## D111 · <archived title>', with the same blank-line separation as the other entries. Change self-references from D112 to D111.
Insert the two CHANGELOG entries under [Unreleased] in the subsection where the archive has them, with D112 changed to D111.
Grep all three files for D112. Check that decisions.md has one D111 and no spec-job text. Run git status and git diff --stat to confirm exactly three paths changed.

risks.risk: The renumbering misses a D112 or hits the wrong one.
risks.mitigation: Grep the three outputs for 'D112' and 'D111'. Check each D111 hit against the records-history decision.

risks.risk: The design references spec-job files or decisions that do not exist on this branch.
risks.mitigation: Grep the outputs for spec.toml, ontology.toml, enforcement and 'spec'. Adjust any hit, and list each adjustment in the final note.

risks.risk: Unrelated lines in CHANGELOG.md or decisions.md are disturbed.
risks.mitigation: Add the entries only with edits at the right positions. Confirm with git diff --stat that only three files changed.

demonstrations.method: Compare the new file with the archived file line by line.
demonstrations.command: git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:docs/design/records-history.md, then git diff and read docs/design/records-history.md against it
demonstrations.observes: The only differences are D112 to D111 and any listed branch-state adjustments.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing file or any text changed beyond D112 to D111 and the branch-state adjustments would show up as extra diff lines.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of decisions.md and compare it with `git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:docs/decisions.md`.
demonstrations.observes: One added '## D111 ·' section after D110, status accepted, citing the BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23, with no D112 heading and no spec-job content.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing or misnumbered entry, an added D112 heading, or the spec job's D111 text would be visible in the diff.

demonstrations.method: Read every D11x occurrence in the added lines of the diff.
demonstrations.observes: No D112 appears, and every D111 refers to the records-history decision.
demonstrations.fails_without: A leftover D112, or a D111 that points at the spec job, would appear in the added lines.

demonstrations.method: Compare the diff with the two archived entries from `git show archive/next4-2026-10-23:CHANGELOG.md`.
demonstrations.observes: Two added bullets under [Unreleased], identical to the archive except D112 became D111, with none for the spec job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Missing entries, entries outside [Unreleased], or spec-job entries would be visible in the diff.

demonstrations.observes: Only docs/design/records-history.md (new), docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md are listed. spec.toml, ontology.toml and enforcement.md are unchanged or absent.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any other changed or new path would be listed.

demonstrations.method: Run git diff --stat and git status, then git diff.
demonstrations.observes: Exactly three paths changed, the D111 renumbering is correct, and there is no spec-job content.
demonstrations.fails_without: Extra paths in the stat, or spec-job text in `git diff`, would show a wrong scope.
